text: The package is in your mailbox, {name}. Open it alone, and tell the innkeeper nothing.
Agent, your {what} have arrived by the usual channel. This letter never existed.
The owl flies at midnight. The goods are attached. Burn this note after reading, or at least vendor it.
Contents classified. If anyone asks, {name}, you found these behind a barrel in the tavern cellar.
Drop complete. I was never at this mailbox, and neither were the {what}.
{name}!! I brought you a thing! It is the best thing! Open it open it open it!
OH BOY OH BOY {what}!! I carried them the whole way and only chewed on one a little bit!
I found stuff and thought of you right away and ran to the mailbox so fast my ears flapped!
Is it here yet? Did you get it? I sent {what}! Tell me I did a good job, {name}!
Mail day is the best day! Everything in here is for you and I am wagging so hard right now!
Listen up, {name}! These supplies did not farm themselves. Put them to use before sundown!
Attention! One shipment of {what}, delivered on schedule. I expect skill-ups, not excuses!
Empty that mailbox on the double, recruit! Bag space is earned, not given!
You call that a stockpile, {name}? Here are your {what}. Now drop and give me twenty crafts!
Inspection is at dawn. Every item in this parcel had better be accounted for and put to work!
Here you go, {name} dear. I packed a little extra, you always look so under-geared.
I wrapped your {what} up nice and warm, sweetie. Do remember to eat something between dungeons.
Just a little something from my bags, pumpkin. No need to send anything back, I have plenty.
Now {name}, do not sell these to the vendor like last time. Grandma worked hard on that farming route.
Some {what} for you, my dear. Put on a cloak before you go out questing, it is drafty in the hills.
Hehehe. Stuff. For you. Do not ask where it came from, {name}, the kobold was not using it.
I crammed {what} into this envelope with my feet. You are welcome. Mostly.
Surprise! It is loot! Or maybe bees! Open it and find out, I already forgot which one I sent.
Took these {what} from my own bank while I was not looking. Enjoy the crimes, {name}!
Shiny things go in the box, box goes to you, I go back in the walls. Good system.
